$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: The painted default: huddlekit.com is light-only and the app login boots light under a light OS preference — a white ground, #181715 ink (oklch(20.5% .004 70) on 2026-11-21), the #ea580d orange primary on a #f5f3f2 warm page wash.

$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: The re-pointed dark set: app.huddlekit.com paints html.dark + data-theme="dark" under prefers-color-scheme, and the marketing site's nested .dark panels (footer, testimonials, MCP card) paint the same roles — resolved --background #0d0c0a (oklch(15.43% .004 70) on 2026-11-21; the footer computed fill is still #0e0b0d), #eeeceb ink, the #ea580d primary kept, borders switching to white-alpha.
